title: Customer Relationship Management Tool (CRM)
description: A multi-dashboard CRM for customer records, sales workflows, automation, reporting, and mobile access.
details: Built a dashboard engine with drag-and-drop cards, configurable KPIs, and reports. Improved API performance by 75% using Redis caching, Kafka queues, and MongoDB indexing; also optimized the frontend and maintain core CRM and access-control modules.

title: Onfield 360 Application Backend
description: A scalable backend for real-time field operations and task monitoring.
details: Engineered the Node.js and Express.js backend supporting field-operation workflows and task tracking.

title: Callzap Application Backend
description: A scalable backend for a calling application.
details: Engineered the Node.js and Express.js backend for Callzap.

title: Centralized Billing & Controller App
description: A multi-tenant billing and controller app for managing feature access across client applications.
details: Built with AI-assisted development, including a unified subscription and feature-flag engine that grants access according to subscription status.

title: Call Sentiment Analysis Platform
description: A multi-tenant platform where users can sign up and upload call recordings for sentiment analysis.
details: Created a call-analysis workflow to help users understand the sentiment expressed in uploaded recordings.

title: Standardized Postman Collections
description: A documented workspace of Postman collections for the product APIs.
details: Designed and documented an exhaustive set of Postman collections to standardize API exploration and testing across products.
